title: Retroviral transduction in cultured murine basophils
protocol: Transfect retroviral constructs into the packaging cell line Phoenix using FuGene-6 reagent as instructed by supplier.
Collect retrovirus-containing supernatants 48 hours after transfection.
Concentrate virus supernatants 10-fold by centrifugation at 8000 g for 12 hours at 4°C.
Filtrate virus supernatants through a 0.22 μm pore PVDF membrane.
Store filtrated supernatants for up to one week at 4°C.
Isolate bone marrow cells from femurs and tibias of 8-12 week old mice.

Culture whole BM cells at 2 to 2.5 × 10^6 cells/ml in RPMI 1640 medium supplemented with penicillin, streptomycin, L-glutamine, β-mercaptoethanol, fetal bovine serum, and recombinant mouse IL-3 for 9 days.
Change the medium every 3 days during culture.
Enrich BM-derived basophils by depleting mast (c-kit+) cells using IMag system or autoMACS as instructed by the supplier.
Treat 12-well plates with RetroNectin solution at 50 μg/ml in PBS for 2 hours at room temperature.
Incubate treated plates with bovine serum albumin at 2% concentration in PBS for 30 minutes.
Incubate treated plates with virus supernatants for 4 hours at 30°C.
Add enriched BM-derived basophils (0.5 to 1 × 10^6 cells/ml) and culture for 2 days for infection.
Wash recovered cells with RPMI 1640 containing 2% FBS.
Starve infected BM-derived basophils by culturing them in culture media without IL-3 for 12 to 18 hours.
Enrich rat CD2+ cells using the IMag system and/or AutoMACS.
